title: 出口强劲之际：财政为何意外收紧，政策组合引关注

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, this is coming in a time when I think, I mean, policymakers have in some ways given what X-port are doing, the strength that we've seen that they actually have tightened fiscal policy.

segments.en: I think for now, if we look at going in the next few months, I think it's likely to be more supportive rather than definitionary because if fiscal spending is indeed coming quicker,
segments.zh: 我认为未来几个月财政支出若加快，将更具支撑性而非通缩性。

segments.en: is sent more support to the construction materials and increase overall these domestic demand, growth even through investment.

segments.en: I think he still has some benefits to the household sectors, for example, through the labor market and etc.

segments.en: I think for the consumer spending, I still think with the ongoing and property market corrections, with the lack of really notable rebound in the labor market, especially related to use employment, the household would still remain quite cautious instead of spending very comfortably.

segments.en: If we look at these numbers in the first half, disposable household income actually was 5.2 percent, which is also below the nominal GDP growth and if we look at the breakdown,
